scanNote:
15-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (108-bet) - UNDOV GAPLAR va SAVOL-QUYRUQLAR.

Yuqorida chapda YaShIL yorliqda oq '15' va 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Exclamations'.
   KO'K-YaShIL QUTI (undov belgisi): 'EXCLAMATIONS using "How + adjective!" or "What a(n) + noun!" are COMMENTS about sth which has happened, or REACTIONS to sb's news/appearance, etc. They show that we are very happy/upset/surprised, etc.' To'q sariq qiya: 'How surprising! How unlucky! How strange! How wonderful! How awful! What a surprise! What a shame/pity! What a beautiful dress! What an awful day!'
14) 'Choose the best response to each statement.' 1 I'm afraid I can't come to your party on Saturday. a) What a pity! b) How disgusting! 2 Guess what - I passed my exams! a) What a nuisance! b) How wonderful! 3 Look at what I've just bought! a) What a beautiful dress! b) How terrible! 4 Bill broke his arm last week. a) How wonderful! b) How awful! 5 I brought you some flowers. a) What a surprise! b) What a shame!
• To'q sariq 'Communication: Reactions & Comments'.
15) Kasseta belgisi: a) 'Complete the dialogues with How or What a, then listen and check your answers.' 1 A: Guess what my parents gave me for my birthday - a computer! B: Really? ...... nice present! A: Yes - and I've already started using the Internet! B: ...... exciting! 2 A: Guess who I saw yesterday! Julie! B: Really? ...... surprise! A: She's back in London. We had dinner together last night. B: ...... wonderful! b) 'Listen again and repeat.'
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Question Tags'.
16) 'Read the examples, then cross out the inappropriate words in bold in the rules.' Ko'k qiya: 'Tony LIKES working on a computer, DOESN'T he? Sheila ISN'T a computer operator, IS she?'

O'NG USTUN:
   KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Form': • 'Question tags are short questions at the BEGINNING/END of statements.' • 'They are formed with the auxiliary verb from the main sentence and the appropriate subject PRONOUN/ADJECTIVE. When there is no auxiliary verb in the main sentence, we use do(n't) or does(n't) in the question tag for the present simple, and did(n't) for the past simple.' • 'A positive statement takes a POSITIVE/NEGATIVE question tag. A negative statement takes a POSITIVE/NEGATIVE question tag.'
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'. KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Intonation': 'When we are sure of the answer, our voice goes DOWN in the question tag (↘). When we are not sure of the answer, our voice goes UP in the question tag (↗).'
17) Kasseta belgisi: a) 'Listen and tick each sentence as ↘ (sure) or ↗ (not sure).' 1 You're from France, aren't you? [↘ belgilangan - namuna] 2 You will be here tomorrow, won't you? 3 I've made a mistake, haven't I? 4 You don't know my name, do you? 5 He has got a sister, hasn't he? 6 This information isn't right, is it? b) 'Listen again and repeat.'
18) 'Fill in the correct question tag.' 1 You've used the Internet before, ......? 2 I can't use e-mail without an address, ......? 3 My modem isn't working, ......? 4 He doesn't like this CD, ......? 5 YHM means you have mail, ......? 6 The personal e-mail name comes before the @ sign, ......? 7 The keyboard was broken, ......? 8 You won't use the computer, ......?

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '108'.

exercises.instructionEn: Exclamations using "How + adjective!" or "What a(n) + noun!" are comments about sth which has happened, or reactions to sb's news/appearance, etc. They show that we are very happy/upset/surprised, etc.
exercises.instructionUz: "How + sifat!" yoki "What a(n) + ot!" bilan undov gaplar - bo'lgan voqea haqidagi izohlar yoki kimningdir yangiligi/ko'rinishiga munosabat. Ular juda xursand/xafa/hayron ekanimizni ko'rsatadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNDOV GAPLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HOW + SIFAT!                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  How surprising! = Qanday
    hayratlanarli!
  How unlucky! = Qanday omadsiz!
  How strange! = Qanday g'alati!
  How wonderful! = Qanday ajoyib!
  How awful! = Qanday dahshatli!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHAT A(N) + (SIFAT) + OT!       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  What a surprise! = Qanday
    kutilmagan hodisa!
  What a shame/pity! = Qanday
    achinarli!
  What a beautiful dress! = Qanday
    chiroyli ko'ylak!
  What an awful day! = Qanday
    dahshatli kun!

  ⚠ 'What A' - sanaladigan birlik
  ot bilan. Sanalmaydigan/ko'plik
  bilan 'a' YO'Q: 'What awful
  weather!', 'What lovely flowers!'


⚠ 'A COMMENT':

  = izoh.


⚠ 'A REACTION':

  = munosabat.


⚠ 'APPEARANCE':

  = tashqi ko'rinish.


⚠ 'UPSET':

  = xafa.

points.en: How + adjective! - How surprising! How unlucky! How strange! How wonderful! How awful!
points.uz: How + sifat! - Qanday hayratlanarli! Qanday omadsiz! Qanday g'alati! Qanday ajoyib! Qanday dahshatli!

points.en: What a(n) + noun! - What a surprise! What a shame/pity! What a beautiful dress! What an awful day!
points.uz: What a(n) + ot! - Qanday kutilmagan hodisa! Qanday achinarli! Qanday chiroyli ko'ylak! Qanday dahshatli kun!

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the best response to each statement.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir gapga eng mos javobni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 a What a pity! (kela olmaydi -
    achinarli)
  2 b How wonderful! (imtihondan
    o'tdi - ajoyib)
  3 a What a beautiful dress! (sotib
    oldi - chiroyli)
  4 b How awful! (qo'lini sindirdi -
    dahshatli)
  5 a What a surprise! (gul olib
    keldi - kutilmagan)


⚠ 'GUESS WHAT':

  = Bilasanmi nima? (yangilik
  aytishdan oldin)


⚠ 'A NUISANCE':

  = bezovtalik, noqulaylik.
  /ˈnjuːsəns/.


⚠ 'DISGUSTING':

  = jirkanch.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 WHAT A nice present! (ot -
    'present')
    HOW exciting! (sifat)

⚠ 'GUESS WHO':

⚠ 'TO BE BACK':

exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL-QUYRUQLAR (QUESTION TAGS).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Gap OXIRIDA qisqa savol:
  '..., isn't it?' / '..., do
  you?'

  Yordamchi fe'l (be, have, will,
  can) + OLMOSh:
  'She IS ..., ISN'T SHE?'
  'You CAN ..., CAN'T YOU?'

  Yordamchi fe'l YO'Q bo'lsa:
  present simple → do/does
  'Tony LIKES ..., DOESN'T he?'
  past simple → did
  'He WENT ..., DIDN'T he?'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IJOBIY ↔ INKOR                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IJOBIY gap → INKOR quyruq:
  'Tony likes ..., DOESN'T he?'
  INKOR gap → IJOBIY quyruq:
  'Sheila isn't ..., IS she?'


JAVOBLAR (to'g'ri so'zlar):
  • at the END of statements
  • subject PRONOUN
  • positive statement → NEGATIVE
    tag; negative statement →
    POSITIVE tag


⚠ MAXSUS:
  'I am ..., AREN'T I?' ('amn't'
  yo'q!)
  'Let's go, SHALL we?'


⚠ 'AN AUXILIARY VERB':

  = yordamchi fe'l.


⚠ 'APPROPRIATE':

  = mos, o'rinli.

items.textEn: Question tags are short questions at the beginning/end of statements.
They are formed with the auxiliary verb from the main sentence and the appropriate subject pronoun/adjective.
items.uz: Ular asosiy gapdagi yordamchi fe'l va mos ega olmoshi/sifati bilan yasaladi.

items.textEn: A positive statement takes a positive/negative question tag.
A negative statement takes a positive/negative question tag.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct question tag.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 You've used ..., HAVEN'T YOU?
    (have → haven't)
  2 I can't use ..., CAN I?
    (can't → can)
  3 My modem isn't working, IS IT?
    (isn't → is; 'my modem' → it)
  4 He doesn't like ..., DOES HE?
    (doesn't → does)
  5 YHM means ..., DOESN'T IT?
    (means - present simple, ijobiy
    → doesn't)
  6 The ... name comes ..., DOESN'T
    IT? (comes → doesn't)
  7 The keyboard was broken, WASN'T
    IT? (was → wasn't)
  8 You won't use ..., WILL YOU?
    (won't → will)


⚠ QADAMLAR:
  1 Yordamchi fe'lni toping (yoki
    do/does/did).
  2 Ijobiy → inkor, inkor → ijobiy.
  3 Egani olmoshga aylantiring.


⚠ 'YHM':

  = 'You Have Mail' - Internet
  qisqartmasi.


⚠ '@ SIGN':

  = 'at' belgisi. /æt/.

exercises.instructionEn: When we are sure of the answer, our voice goes down in the question tag (↘). When we are not sure of the answer, our voice goes up in the question tag (↗). a) Listen and tick each sentence as ↘ (sure) or ↗ (not sure). b) Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Javobga ishonchimiz komil bo'lsa, savol-quyruqda ovozimiz pasayadi (↘). Javobga ishonchimiz komil bo'lmasa, savol-quyruqda ovozimiz ko'tariladi (↗). a) Tinglang va har gapni ↘ (ishonch) yoki ↗ (ishonchsiz) deb belgilang. b) Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - intonatsiya faqat
yozuvdan. 1 = ↘ (kitobda).


INTONATSIYa:

  ↘ PASAYADI = ishonchim komil,
    tasdiq kutaman:
    'You're from France, aren't
     you?' ↘ (bilaman, tasdiqla)

  ↗ KO'TARILADI = ishonchim yo'q,
    haqiqiy savol:
    'You're from France, aren't
     you?' ↗ (bilmayman, so'rayapman)

  ⚠ Xuddi shu so'zlar - ohang
  ma'noni o'zgartiradi.


⚠ 'SURE':

  = ishonchli, amin.
